topic.title: Relecloud said to be exploring sale of messaging unit
topic.angle: What a sale would mean for enterprise messaging buyers

sources.title: Relecloud weighs options for messaging business
sources.text: Relecloud is exploring options for its enterprise messaging unit, including a possible sale, according to a person familiar with the company's thinking. No decision has been made and talks are at an early stage, the person said. Consolidated Messenger has been mentioned as a possible buyer. Relecloud did not respond to a request for comment.
